integrations_researched.name: Supabase Row Level Security (RLS)

api_patterns.initialization: ALTER TABLE table_name ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
key_functions: CREATE POLICY policy_name ON table FOR operation USING (condition)
Custom helper functions: is_super_admin(), user_has_role_in_org(), get_user_organization_ids()
SECURITY DEFINER functions for bypassing RLS

gotchas: RLS must be enabled on EVERY table for security
Helper functions (is_super_admin, etc.) must be created before policies
SECURITY DEFINER functions bypass RLS - use carefully
anon role for unauthenticated users, authenticated role for logged-in users
Use GRANT statements to control table-level access before RLS

organization_members table - Maps users to organizations with roles

gotchas: Every tenant-specific table MUST have organization_id column

member_role ENUM: owner, admin, manager, waiter

integrations_researched.name: Immutable Price Ledger Pattern

key_functions: close_current_price() - SECURITY DEFINER function to close old price period
getCurrentPrice() - Get active price at current time
getPriceAtTime() - Get price at specific timestamp

gotchas: NEVER update price_ledger records - INSERT only
Database trigger prevents UPDATE/DELETE on price_ledger
close_current_price() uses SECURITY DEFINER to set valid_until
Snapshots created automatically on price changes for audit compliance
Turkish Ministry of Trade compliance requires immutable price history

checkFeature(orgId, featureKey) - Get detailed result with reason
getAllFeatures(orgId) - Get all features for caching

gotchas: NEVER hard-code package checks (if plan === 'Pro' is FORBIDDEN)
Override priority: organization_feature_overrides > plan_features
Check override expiry before applying
Return -1 for unlimited, 0 for no access in limit functions

unverified_claims.claim: Specific Turkish Ministry of Trade API integration requirements
unverified_claims.reason: No external API documentation found for official ministry integration. The system implements local compliance (immutable records, audit trails) but external API integration requirements are unclear.
Specific retention periods for price history data under Turkish law not verified. Current implementation keeps all history indefinitely.

recommendations: Use @supabase/ssr for all server-side Supabase operations in Next.js 15
Always use getUser() instead of getSession() for server-side authentication
Implement comprehensive RLS policies before going to production
Use SECURITY DEFINER functions sparingly and only for specific operations like closing price periods
Consider implementing rate limiting for public QR-triggered service requests
Add database-level constraints to enforce immutability alongside application logic
Implement proper error boundaries for React Server Components
Use React 19's built-in async component support for data fetching
Consider implementing Redis caching for feature flag checks to reduce database load
